scenario: Group id that does not exist (or is not owned) yields 404 matching the resource-not-found convention
notes: contract change (owner-approved status-code consistency fix). Flask mapped GroupsMixin.create_group_option's ValueError('Group not found for user') to 400; the Rust port now returns 404 with the same body DELETE /api/groups/{id} uses for a missing/foreign group. The data layer's error is untouched; the route remaps it. Filename kept for history; the recorded status is now 404.
